_artifact_note: DERIVED record of two Scite MCP `search_literature` term-search pages made 2026-09-05 (offset 0, limit 10) and 2026-09-06 (offset 10, limit 12), after the service-reported quota reset of 2026-09-03, for the one thing C1 lacked: an IL10 LIGAND cohort. Transcribed from the tool responses: the reported total, and the DOI, year and title of EVERY returned record. Scite reported 22 total hits and returned 17 records across the two pages; the second page returned 7 where 12 were requested, so 17 is the complete result set the API would yield. Abstracts, excerpts and Smart Citation snippets were not retained. Outcome, from the titles: none of the 17 is an IL10 ligand loss-of-function cohort (other genes, reviews, congress proceedings, an IL-10RA knock-in model), so C1 stays WITHHELD.

_query.term: IL10 AND "loss-of-function" AND "early-onset inflammatory bowel disease" AND ("autosomal recessive" OR homozygous) NOT IL10RA NOT IL10RB
